papers.title: 机器人操作基准测试究竟在测什么？四类失效模式系统审计
papers.titleEn: What Are We Actually Benchmarking in Robot Manipulation?
papers.summary: 固定设置下的操作基准得分常被直接当成通用操作能力的证明。本文系统识别四类基准失效模式——捷径可解、缺乏统计显著性、渐进过拟合与数据源依赖，并对LIBERO、CALVIN、SimplerEnv、RoboCasa与RoboTwin 2.0开展诊断审计。研究发现0.09B无语言编码器探针即可在LIBERO逼近SOTA，多数报告涨幅缺乏统计显著性；该审计警醒意义极大，但真机基准尚未纳入同等量化审计。
papers.summaryEn: Single-setup manipulation benchmark scores are routinely cited as proof of general capability. This paper identifies four failure modes—shortcut solvability, weak statistical significance, creeping overfitting, and data-source dependence—and audits LIBERO, CALVIN, SimplerEnv, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin 2.0. On LIBERO, a 0.09B probe without a language encoder nears reported SOTA while many claimed gains lack statistical significance; the audit is eye-opening, though real-world benchmarks await similar rigor.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Oral；用严谨诊断戳破当前主流操作基准的虚高 SOTA 幻觉，是每位机器人研究者与入门者的必读防坑指南。

papers.title: GRAIL：基于3D锚定视频世界模型生成人形全身移动操作数据
papers.titleEn: GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from World Models
papers.summary: 人形全身移动操作受制于遥操作与动捕成本极高。GRAIL提出全虚拟生成管线：先在已知物体几何、相机参数、真实尺度与机器人比例角色的3D仿真场景中做条件化，再调用视频世界模型合成人机交互视频并重建为物理可追踪的全身轨迹，实现无需物理搭建场景即可训练并零样本真机部署。它规避了野生视频尺度歧义，但生成物理幻觉与精细手指接触仍需过滤。
papers.summaryEn: Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation is bottlenecked by physical teleoperation and mocap setups. GRAIL builds a fully digital pipeline that grounds video world models in metric 3D scenes with known object geometry, cameras, and robot-proportioned characters, synthesizing interactions and reconstructing physically trackable whole-body motions for sim-to-real deployment. Grounding avoids unconstrained video scale ambiguity, though video physics hallucinations and fine finger contacts still require filtering.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Oral；用“3D场景先验+视频世界模型”打通人形全身移动操作虚拟数据合成与真机迁移闭环。

papers.title: SCoCaT：面向终端安全导航的成功条件化终止约束强化学习
papers.titleEn: SCoCaT: Success Conditioned Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Spacecraft Docking
papers.summary: 基于违规终止的约束强化学习部署轻量，无需在线求解优化器，但在终端高精度对接等安全走廊不断收窄的任务中会出现“策略停在安全边界外不敢进目标”的结构性失效。SCoCaT揭示该机理并引入成功条件化终止约束，通过双评论家机制在保证安全约束的同时消除过度保守滞留，并在气浮平台对接实验上验证。该方法原理优雅，但复杂多障碍非凸任务泛化仍需考察。
papers.summaryEn: Termination-based constrained RL is lightweight at inference, yet suffers a structural failure mode on terminal navigation tasks where tightening safety corridors make dwelling outside the goal preferable to approaching it. SCoCaT diagnoses this survival-bias trap and introduces success-conditioned termination constraints via a two-critic formulation, validated on an air-bearing spacecraft docking testbed. While theoretically clean, generalization to complex multi-obstacle non-convex tasks needs further study.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Spotlight；精准定位终止型安全 RL 的“过保守拒近目标”病灶并给出有理论证明与实物平台验证的解法。

papers.title: SADP：利用基础模型生成子目标示范的长时程扩散策略
papers.titleEn: SADP: Subgoal-Aware Diffusion Policy for Long-Horizon Manipulation Learned From Foundation Model Generated Demonstrations
papers.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters（RA-L 2026 · Vol. 11 No. 11 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 多数模仿学习仅依赖整段任务示范，缺乏对当前活跃子目标与阶段切换时机的显式建模，长时程任务极易中途漂移。SADP先借助基础模型自动生成带结构化子目标与延续标签的示范，再训练带延续预测头的子目标感知扩散策略，在线判定何时推进至下一子目标。该设计把高层语义进度显式融入低层扩散控制，但对基础模型自动生成的子目标切分质量较敏感。
papers.summaryEn: Standard imitation learning trains on task-level demonstrations without modeling active subgoals or stage transitions, causing drift on long-horizon tasks. SADP leverages foundation models to autonomously generate demonstrations annotated with structured subgoals and continuation labels, training a subgoal-aware diffusion policy with a continuation head to decide online when to advance stages. This bridges semantic progress and low-level diffusion control, though quality depends on automated subgoal segmentation.
papers.whySelected: IEEE RA-L 2026 年 11 月期正式发表；将子目标延续预测头引入扩散策略并自动化采集子目标示范，切中长时程漂移痛点。

papers.title: 面向非抓握移动操作的多评论家接触引导强化学习探索
papers.titleEn: Contact-Guided Exploration for Non-Prehensile Locomanipulation With Multi-Critic RL
papers.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters（RA-L 2026 · Vol. 11 No. 11 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 推搬大型沉重物体等非抓握移动操作接触稀疏、动力学混杂，标准强化学习极难探索到有效接触点。本文提出多评论家RL框架：用通用抓取算法生成物体候选接触先验，训练独立探索评论家提供稠密寻接触奖励，并随训练衰减其权重以恢复任务最优策略，在四足移动操作平台上实现真机推搬与铰接物体交互。方法通用性强，但强摩擦未知表面与视觉遮挡下仍受限于物体位姿估计。
papers.summaryEn: Non-prehensile locomanipulation of heavy or bulky objects suffers from hybrid dynamics and sparse contacts that stall standard RL exploration. This paper proposes a Multi-Critic RL framework that extracts candidate object contact points from a general grasping model to train a dedicated exploration critic whose influence decays over time to recover task-optimal policies, validated on real legged locomanipulation hardware. While versatile across geometries, real deployment still depends on object pose estimation.
papers.whySelected: IEEE RA-L 2026 年 11 月期正式发表；ETH 与比萨大学团队用衰减式独立探索评论家破解非抓握移动操作稀疏接触难题。

papers.title: PG-Constraints 约束下的属性图修复算法与管线
papers.venue: PVLDB Vol. 19 No. 6（2026 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 随着 GQL 与 SQL/PGQ 图查询及 PG-Constraints 约束标准化，属性图数据不一致时的自动修复成为关键缺口。本文界定了一类支持递归且可做自动机结构错误分析的否定型 PG-Constraints 子集，提出结合节点/边及可选标签删除的完整修复管线，并系统评估 ILP、朴素贪心与 LP 引导贪心三种策略。工作兼顾图约束理论与系统可扩展性，但暂不支持值修改或增边修复。
papers.summaryEn: As GQL, SQL/PGQ, and PG-Constraints standardize graph databases, repairing inconsistent property graphs becomes essential. This paper identifies a recursive denial subset of PG-Constraints amenable to automata-based error analysis, builds a repair pipeline over node, edge, and optional label deletions, and compares ILP, naive greedy, and LP-guided greedy algorithms. It balances graph constraint theory and scalability, though value-update and insertion repairs remain outside scope.
papers.whySelected: PVLDB 2026 正式期刊长文；Angela Bonifati 团队面向最新图约束标准的属性图自动修复系统，直击李的图/约束修复核心方向。

li.whyRead: 必看图修复代表作：看懂递归图约束如何结合自动机分析与 ILP/LP 贪心做最小代价修复。
li.relation: 将关系数据库 constraint repair 拓展至标准化属性图与递归模式约束。
prerequisites: 属性图与路径查询 / Property graphs and RPQs
整数线性规划基础 / ILP basics

limits: 修复动作聚焦节点、边及可选标签删除，尚未支持属性值更新或补全缺失边以消除违约。 / Repair operations focus on node, edge, and optional label deletions rather than property updates or edge insertions.
所支持约束限于特定否定型 PG-Constraints 片段，不覆盖含全称存在依赖的生成型图约束。 / Targets a denial subset of PG-Constraints rather than general tuple-generating graph dependencies.
assumptions: 属性图违规模式可表示为所定义的正则图模式否定约束，且可为图元素赋予删除重要度权重。 / Assumes violations are expressible in the supported recursive denial PG-Constraint fragment with deletion weights.
